gap_details.2011-2012: No PCOM neurosurgery roster in Wayback or Common Crawl (old site had only a program page, first captured 2015; link audit of GME index pages 2010-2019 found no roster). PubMed affiliation mining found PCOM neurosurgery residents not on any roster: Leslie Lyness ('Neurosurgical Residency Program, PCOM', 2011, PMID 21707239), Douglas Stofko (PCOM Dept of Neurosurgery 2013, PMID 24231690; Capital Health Aug 2013), Mark Rivkin (PCOM/Cooper neurosurgery 2013-14; named program alumnus in PCOM news Jan 2017). PCOM news Jan 2017 also names alumnus Bryan Bolinger DO '07. All are pre-2011 entrants who finished by 2014; their exact years are unknown, so they are not added to the roster.
gap_details.2012-2013: Same as 2011-12. Only one 2012 entrant (Lynagh) is known.
gap_details.2013-2014: Same as 2011-12. Rivkin's last PCOM/Cooper affiliations are 2013-14 (probable June 2014 graduate).
gap_details.2014-2015: Observed but INCOMPLETE: PCOM WordPress current-residents page (2015-04-17, spring, only capture) lists PGY2-PGY6 only; interns (PGY1, e.g. the 2014 entrants Georges/Brooking/Kakareka) not listed.
gap_details.2015-2016: No roster capture in Wayback or Common Crawl (WordPress subsite captured only 2015-04/08; CC has only the roster-less Res-Neurosurgery page). Reconstructed: Ploof, Ishak, Lynagh (bracketed 2014-15/2017-18) + alumni-confirmed 2014/2015 entrants. Xin, Patel (PGY-4 in 2014-15) and Svokos, Okun (PGY-5) not seen again - probably finished at AOA PGY-6 in 2016/2017, unverified.
gap_details.2016-2017: As 2015-16 (CC 2016-40..2017-39 have only the roster-less program page neurosurgery.html).
gap_details.2017-2018: Observed via Common Crawl only (CC-MAIN-2018-13, 2018-03-22, spring; neurosurgery-residents.html not in Wayback before 2019-08). Content-dated 2017-18: Badger/Zaher PGY-1. Complete PGY1-6 list (12).
gap_details.2018-2019: PCOM residents page STALE all year (every CC crawl 2018-05..2019-06, including the phase-2 retry of CC-MAIN-2019-18 (2019-04-26), shows the 2017-18 list). Reconstructed alumni-confirmed residents plus Mark Ishak PGY-6 (first author, PCOM Research Day 2019 poster, Digital Commons neurosurgery_residents). Ploof not placed (no in-year evidence) but completion recorded.
gap_details.2021-2022: Only capture is PCOM 2022-05-28 (spring); content-dated 2021-22. Kakareka (PGY-7 in 2020-21) absent although the Cooper alumni page lists him as class of 2022.
gap_details.2025-2026: Old Cooper residents page stale (Oct-2025 = 2024-25 list); Feb-2026 trainees capture empty; used June-2026 trainees capture (content-dated 2025-26). Bamimore listed PGY-3 (expected PGY-4).

departures.name: Michael Bamimore
departures.note: entered 2022; PGY-3 in both 2024-25 and 2025-26 (June 2026 capture lists him under PGY-3 with Morse; no PGY-4 heading); absent from live 2026-27 (no PGY-5). Cooper Neurological Surgery affiliation Dec 2025 (PMID 41613670). No program page or publication shows a destination or specialty switch; NPPES (general practice taxonomy, Dallas TX mailing address, updated 2026-06-30) is not evidence. Recorded training_history completed='unknown' -> LEFT, outcome unknown.

adjudication_summary.note: phase 2: the 9 AOA-era unknowns resolved as completions (3 PGY-terminal roster, 6 inferred from later neurosurgery affiliations/program evidence); Bamimore changed from NPI 'switched specialty' to outcome unknown.

problems: Phase 1 CC failures CC-MAIN-2017-43, 2018-26, 2019-18 all retried successfully in phase 2. OpenAlex (429) and Europe PMC (503) unavailable; PubMed used instead. PCOM Alumni_Data.pdf / Residency_History-1.pdf never archived (Wayback and CC) and 404 live. Kakareka alumni-year (2022) vs 2021-22 PCOM roster conflict unchanged.

2011-2012.reason: No PCOM roster exists (pre-2015 site had none; WordPress subsite started late 2014). Entrants 2011 (Xin, Patel) = full class of 2 seen 2014-15; other residents that year were pre-2011 entrants (Bolinger DO'07, Stofko, Rivkin, Lyness, per PubMed/PCOM news) who finished by 2014.

2012-2013.reason: No roster. 2012 entry class shows only Lynagh (complement 2/yr, 12 positions): a second 2012 entrant who left before April 2015 would be invisible.

2013-2014.reason: No roster. Same 2012-class risk; 2013 class (Ploof, Ishak) full.

2014-2015.reason: PGY-1 not listed, but the 2014 interns are the 3 alumni-confirmed entrants (Georges, Brooking, Kakareka) - above the 2/yr complement, so an extra unseen intern is unlikely.

2015-2016.reason: No capture. Everyone who left is now accounted for (Svokos, Okun completed 2016 per later neurosurgery affiliations); 2015 class (Moncman, Valeri) full at 2 and seen 2017-18.

2016-2017.reason: No capture. Xin, Patel completed 2017 (later neurosurgery affiliations); 2016 class (Lopez, Schreiber) full at 2; complete 12-name roster in March 2018 brackets the gap.

2018-2019.reason: Stale page all year (CC-MAIN-2019-18 retry = 2017-18 list again). Ishak placed by PCOM Research Day 2019 poster; Ploof, Lynagh completions recorded; 2018 entrant Wojcik (complement now 1/yr) bracketed/alumnus.

2021-2022.reason: Spring capture only (2022-05); Kakareka absent but alumni page gives class of 2022.

2026-2027.reason: Live trainees page (re-fetched 2026-09-28: PGY7 Ifrach, PGY6 Charcos, no PGY5, PGY4 Morse, PGY3 Batchu, PGY2 Hashmi, PGY1 Jagtiani, Swarna).
